## Type of change
- [ ] feat: new feature
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] chore: tooling / config / deps
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] refactor: code restructure, no behaviour change
- [ ] test: tests only

## Testing done
<!-- What did you test? How? Include commands run if applicable. -->


## Checklist
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, API keys, or credentials in any file
- [ ] `.env` is NOT committed (only `.env.example` if keys changed)
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes locally
- [ ] All existing tests pass (`pytest backend/tests/`)
- [ ] New code has a file header (purpose / owner / date / deps)
- [ ] PR targets `main` — not pushing directly to main
- [ ] CODEOWNERS notified (at least one approval required)
